description: Derivation of stellar-pulsation response coefficient eta_P

geometric_contribution.source: Modified acoustic crossing time in disformal metric
geometric_contribution.derivation: Delta P/P = -epsilon/4 from r_tilde = (1+eps/2)r, c_s_tilde = c_s(1+3eps/4)

radiative_correction.source: Modified opacity and temperature profile in radiative envelope

consistency_check.note: The paper claims epsilon_env ~ 1e-7, but the correct value from the formula is ~6%. This is still below spectroscopic constraints for frequency shifts, and the disformal coupling is a spatial distortion (not a frequency shift), so the relevant constraint is on stellar dynamics (~10%).
